title: Add release workflow global-install smoke test
description: Add release automation that installs the packed @loreweaver/core and @loreweaver/cli artifacts into a clean npm prefix and invokes the global loreweaver command before publish. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r. This follows from loreweaver-8v8: the repo now has package-content smoke coverage via npm pack --dry-run, but the first publish still needs an end-to-end clean-prefix install smoke in CI/release automation.
acceptance_criteria: Release workflow or script packs both workspaces, installs the tarballs into a clean prefix without fetching unpublished workspace packages, invokes loreweaver, verifies the expected config guidance, and documents how to run the smoke locally.
close_reason: Added CI-backed clean-prefix CLI install smoke script and docs; verification: npm run typecheck, npm run test, and npm run smoke:cli-install passed.
